system.description: When the Nashorn was announced, those of who keep a close eye on the firearms industry shocked at the idea of a man-portable coilgun. they won’t miniaturize the chemrail any time soon, we all said to each other. Three months later, jaws dropped. The Colossus is a huge shoulder-fired chemrail, designed as a crew-served weapon. Because it is a big tube a little over 2 meters long, the first time saw one I assumed it was a new man-portable rocket launcher. But on closer inspection, I noticed the rear 1.2 meters of the tube is 50 percent larger diameter than the front portion, and half a meter from the rear is the huge half-meter-diameter drum magazine for this thing! Thankfully there is a grip to help hold on to the damn thing. As a chemrail, the Colossus fires a penetrator that has an initial powder charge and accelerates it using a normal railgun. However, YNT has gone one step further and included forward-projecting ionized gas cloud that has effect of extending the length of the rails without physically extending the barrel.
